formationCta.title: Go further with a hands-on course
formationCta.text: Enjoyed this article? Put it into practice with a course built for real, concrete results.

agencyExit.title: Before you go
agencyExit.intro: Tell us what you're looking for and we'll point you to the right place.
agencyExit.buildDesc: Platform, application, rebuild — this is the practice that handles it.
agencyExit.presenceLabel: I want to digitalise my shop
agencyExit.presenceDesc: Website, Google listing, WhatsApp catalogue. Published prices.
agencyExit.learnDesc: Digital marketing, SEO, AI — hands-on courses and free content.

formationsEntry.title: You're in the right place to learn
formationsEntry.text: Digital marketing, SEO, artificial intelligence: hands-on courses built to be applied the very next day.

formationExit.title: One second
formationExit.text: You can start this course today and move at your own pace. Lifetime access, certificate included.
formationExit.clubDesc: Every course, the community and live sessions, for a single subscription.

presenceExit.title: Shall we price your project?
presenceExit.text: Tell me what you sell and where you are. I'll send a costed proposal back on WhatsApp, no strings attached.

blogEnd.title: You read it all the way through
blogEnd.text: There's no email newsletter yet — I have no sending channel, and I'm not asking you to fill in a field that does nothing. Here are the two ways to keep up.
blogEnd.noEmail: The alert lands in your space, not in your inbox.

cartRecovery.title: You didn't finish
cartRecovery.eyebrow: Pick up where you left off
cartRecovery.text: Your course is still waiting. Only the payment is left to complete.

clubExit.title: There's one step first
clubExit.text: The “Join the Club” button leads to your space, and your space needs an account. The account is free and takes a minute. The subscription itself comes right after, from the Club tab.
clubExit.note: No payment starts here: the amount is recalculated in your space.

mediaEnd.title: The rest happens live
mediaEnd.eyebrow: You made it to the end
mediaEnd.text: Podcasts and videos stay free to access, this one included. What isn't: the live sessions, the workshops and the Club missions — where you practise instead of listen.

install.title: Keep your lessons offline.
install.body: Once installed, the lessons you downloaded read back with no network and no data.

offline.unsupported: Your browser can't keep things offline.
offline.unsupportedBody: This needs a recent browser, and it doesn't work in private browsing. Your lessons stay available online, as usual.
offline.emptyBody: On a lesson, « Keep offline » downloads it once. You can then read it back with no network and no data.
offline.keptBody: Readable with no network and no data.
offline.wifiOnlyBody: So it doesn't eat into your data.
offline.wifiOnlyBlind: This browser won't tell me which network you're on, so I can't hold anything back here: as long as you start the download yourself, you're the one deciding. On Android the setting holds.
offline.wifiOnlyHolding: You're on mobile data: I'm downloading nothing while this is on.
offline.wifiOnlyPassing: You're on Wi-Fi: downloads go through.
offline.queueEmptyBody: Nothing is waiting to go out. What you do without network is written here, and it stays through a reload.
offline.queueBody: The queue goes out when the network comes back, without asking you anything. A run broken off and picked up days later is still a valid run.
offline.queueBodyLocal: These are written on this device and survive a reload. I don't send them back on my own yet: when the network returns, do them again — the list is here so you know which ones, and nothing clears until you have.
offline.ageSource: measured from the moment it was queued
offline.wifiOnlySpending: You're on mobile data and the setting is off: what you download comes out of your data.

notifications.emptyBody: Your enrolments, your certificates, new content and Club announcements land here. It's the only place I reach you — I don't send email.
notifications.truthTitle: Why this screen matters so much
notifications.truthBody: It's the only outbound channel the product has: no email goes out yet. A nudge that doesn't arrive here arrives nowhere.
